name: @teactjs/telegram
description: Telegram platform adapter for Teact, powered by grammY

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target bun --external @teactjs/renderer --external @teactjs/react --external @teactjs/runtime --external @teactjs/telegram --external @teactjs/storage --external grammy --external @grammyjs/auto-retry --external @grammyjs/conversations --external @grammyjs/stream && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --declaration --project tsconfig.build.json
